text:
ben (finance): Quick sync — we discovered a ledger drift after the March ingest wobble. ~2300 invoices show token totals that don't match upstream events. Need containment plan, owners, and customer messaging cadence. TL;DR and asks below.

lia (eng-ml): Short technical summary: during the midnight deploy the new batching window changed how events were grouped. Some publisher retries created an alternate write path that doubled event writes for a subset of partitions for ~4m. Our downstream stitcher merged some duplicates but not all; that produced ledger rows with inflated token counts. I pushed a local repro and a short script to enumerate divergence.

zack (eng-sre): Containment done: rolled ff to disable the alternate write path at 00:42 PT and paused the nightly ingest. No new divergences since. Also placed a temporary block on auto-finalize invoices (billing pipeline) until we reconcile.

billing-bot: Opened BIL-5020: "ledger-drift-containment" and BIL-5021: "invoice-freeze-gate". Linked both to INC-90214. Generated affected-account CSV (S3 link).

ben (finance): Action items (assign please):
- @noah (platform): own the corrective merge/reconciliation pipeline + validation (48h).
- @lia (eng-ml): provide producer patch and regression test to prevent alternate write path; add chaos test for partition retries (72h).
- @zack (eng-sre): runbook updates + safe unfreeze checklist + coordinate rollback windows (24h).
- @gina (support): draft outbound comms + hold queue for customers flagged as impacted (EOD).
Finance: will coordinate credits/adjustments after validation.

gina (support): Acknowledged. I'll prep two versions of comms: 1) brief incident notice, 2) detailed reconciliation timeline. Posting drafts to #support-drafts by 16:00 PT. Will include how customers can request manual remediation.

noah (platform): Reconciliation plan (high level): 1) identify diverging invoices via ledger hash diff; 2) compute canonical token_total by replaying events for the window with idempotent dedupe; 3) apply a single atomic patch to invoice rows; 4) surface audit CSV for finance before any crediting. Draft SQL to locate candidates:

```sql
SELECT i.account_id, i.invoice_id, i.token_total AS invoice_tokens, ev.replay_tokens AS replay_tokens, ABS(i.token_total - ev.replay_tokens) AS delta
FROM invoices i
JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(token_delta) AS replay_tokens
  FROM metering_events_replay
  WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-21 00:30:00' AND '2026-03-21 00:38:00'
  GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
) ev ON ev.account_id = i.account_id AND ev.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
WHERE ABS(i.token_total - ev.replay_tokens) > 50
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 4000;
```

I'll run a dry-run in staging and post a reconciliation diff file. Note: the replay job will be idempotent and produce a reconciliation token per invoice for audit.

lia (eng-ml): I'll open the producer patch PR in the next 3 hours. The patch changes the batching key to include producer_instance_id + sequence_window and adds a small probabilistic dedupe short-circuit at publish time. Regression tests will include simulated producer restarts and retries.

zack (eng-sre): Rollout ops: prefer 00:00–02:00 PT window, ff-first, canary 5% of partitions. If reconciliation CI shows >0.01% mismatch in staging abort. I'll add a step to the deploy playbook: validate consumer lag = 0 before enabling writes.

billing-bot: Note: To avoid accidental billing, BIL-5021 will pause invoice finalization for accounts in the affected CSV until sign-off from BIL-5020 verification.

ben (finance): Please ACK and confirm ETAs if different. Also, we should track long-term mitigations: periodic ledger hash audits and a new alert on per-invoice delta spikes. I'll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT and a full retro the following week.

noah (platform): ACK. Dry-run on staging by 48h; will post validation checklist and CSV for finance review.

lia (eng-ml): ACK. PR pinged in ~3h.

zack (eng-sre): ACK. Runbook patch in 6h.

gina (support): ACK. Drafts to #support-drafts by 16:00 PT.

billing-bot: Automated: BIL-5020, BIL-5021 created, linked to INC-90214. Affected CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-90214/affected.csv

ben (finance): Closing note: after reconciliation we need a short customer-facing summary + a list of accounts refunded/adjusted. Please keep communications factual and include timelines. I'll post a progress check here tomorrow 09:30 PT. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
